conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, focusing on income and broad market exposure. Expect lower volatility but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate growth with controlled drawdown.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It leans into leverage and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware that this approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay.
